routers.name: rr01

config.frr.conf:
frr defaults traditional
hostname rr01
service integrated-vtysh-config
log stdout
interface lo
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
 ip ospf passive
!
interface net1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
interface net2
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
interface net3
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
interface net4
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 192.0.2.1
 max-metric router-lsa administrative
!
bgp no-rib
router bgp 64512
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.1
 bgp cluster-id 192.0.2.254
 no bgp default ipv4-unicast
 neighbor 192.0.2.11 remote-as 64512
 neighbor 192.0.2.11 update-source 192.0.2.1
 neighbor 192.0.2.12 remote-as 64512
 neighbor 192.0.2.12 update-source 192.0.2.1
 neighbor 192.0.2.13 remote-as 64512
 neighbor 192.0.2.13 update-source 192.0.2.1
 neighbor 192.0.2.14 remote-as 64512
 neighbor 192.0.2.14 update-source 192.0.2.1
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 192.0.2.11 activate
  neighbor 192.0.2.11 route-reflector-client
  neighbor 192.0.2.12 activate
  neighbor 192.0.2.12 route-reflector-client
  neighbor 192.0.2.13 activate
  neighbor 192.0.2.13 route-reflector-client
  neighbor 192.0.2.14 activate
  neighbor 192.0.2.14 route-reflector-client
 exit-address-family
!
